narrative: Reports of oil tankers exploding following mine strikes in the Strait of Hormuz dominate weekend headlines, setting up a sharp safe-haven bid for the U.S. dollar at Sunday's open. The geopolitical escalation amplifies hawkish Fed expectations following hot CPI data, likely keeping broad USD momentum intact for the Tokyo open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1028; persistent energy supply risks are likely to weigh further on the pair at the open despite structural cheapness. USD/JPY closed Friday at 159.69, where elevated safe-haven USD demand and wide carry spreads set up potential test of 160.00 ahead of Fed Governor Jefferson's speech.
